title: Ken Steacy
description: Explains Ken Steacy: "The scene I chose to depict is based on a throwaway line Luke delivers late in the first  film —'l used to bull's-eye womp rats in my T-16 back home.' I knew what a T-16 was; Luke toys with a model of one early in the film, but what the hell was a 'womp rat'? Well, now we know! Thanx, George... l hope I got it right!" Writer-illustrator Steacy has depicted practically every major fantasy-heroic character you could name, including Luke Skywalker (for Marvel).
